outgoing.explanation: The unimaged Crowe will could convert the East Bilney geography into a stated kinship.

shortLabel: Open: Bozoune Crowe's PCC will (PROB 11/289/177) is unimaged and may name Gournay kin

sources.locator: TNA Discovery: PROB 11/289/177, 'Will of Bozann Crome, Gentleman of East Bilney, Norfolk,' 11 March 1659; see also PROB 11/120/482 (Christopher Crowe of East Bilney, proved 14 November 1612)

statement: Bozoune Crowe's will — made 15 September 1658 and proved 11 March 1658/9 — survives as PROB 11/289/177, catalogued at The National Archives under a misrendering of both names, "Will of Bozann Crome, Gentleman of East Bilney, Norfolk." It was found by a place-anchored catalogue probe after surname probes failed, and no image has been pulled. Whether it names his wife Elizabeth's Gournay kin is the one document that could convert the East Bilney geography into a stated kinship.
